description: Final cutover (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §7 Phase 4): with every route ported and the scrapers unified, make the Python FastAPI service the sole backend, delete the Node/Express server and all remaining TS backend + vestigial deps, and confirm full parity. After this, Pinakes is one Python service + a React client + the isolated ml/ workspace.

userStories.title: Confirm full route parity, then serve everything from Python
userStories.description: Verify the 501 coverage tracker is empty (every route ported) and the FastAPI service serves the built web/ client plus all /api/* routes in one process.
acceptanceCriteria: The not-yet-ported (501) coverage tracker is empty — every /api/* route the client uses passes the parity tests against the Python service.
The FastAPI service serves the web/ build at the root and all API routes in one process (no sidecar, no Node).
An end-to-end smoke (start the Python service, load the client, exercise graph + a write flow) passes.

userStories.title: Delete the Node/Express backend + vestigial deps
userStories.description: Remove server/ (Node/Express), the now-unused root Node build tooling for the backend, and any remaining vestigial dependencies. Keep web/'s own Node toolchain (Vite build) intact.
acceptanceCriteria: server/ and the Express entrypoint/build (esbuild bundling of the server) are removed; package.json no longer defines a Node backend dev/start/build.
web/ still builds via Vite; the Python service serves its output.
`git grep -in culturescrape` across the whole repo returns nothing outside historical docs/archive.
A fresh clone can build web/, start the Python service, and run the full suite via .chief/verify.sh green.
